3. Cache.Close — store/cache/cache.go:187 — called transitively from Store.Close via server/server.go:146 (lines 74-76 in store/store.go)
4. sqlite.DB.Close — store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67 — called transitively from Store.Close via server/server.go:146 (line 78 in store/store.go)

(postgres.DB.Close at store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46 and mysql.DB.Close at store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47 are alternative implementations depending on database configuration, but never both invoked in a single run)

The 6 distinct Close method declarations are across:
1. SSEHub
2. Cache (shared for 3 cache instances)
3. Store
4. sqlite.DB
5. postgres.DB  
6. mysql.DB

The invoked ones from non-test server code are SSEHub, Store, and one of the three DB implementations (depending on configuration), plus the Cache instances closed transitively through Store.Close().
